# Play Music

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Plays or pauses the current music.

## Syntax

~~~~text
play(behavior: <#Enumeration (WFPlayPauseBehavior)#>, source: <#Variable (Optional)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
play(behavior: Play, source: iPhone)
~~~~
